title: Step 69-F FX rate source rule impact preview and apply administration
description: Implement HIGH-risk AD-D-04 and AD-D-05 Admin FX administration on top of canonical Step69-E: currency-rate read/current, manual register, provider refresh preview, reject/select, FX-linked rule list/detail/create/update/status, impact preview, and Step-Up + idempotent currency apply. Preserve source-proven authority only; do not claim production FX-provider readiness, requester binding, fresh apply-time Profit Guard, current-price recheck, generic FX operation status, Excel authority, Backend/OpenAPI/database changes, Step70 scope, or Graph/Graphify.

dependencies.evidence: PR #374 exact artifact daacb225815022d629c7ca265668563c11d7921856bbc06bb4e4781257dafa80 merged after CI/Phase A/CodeQL/Review/Security/Lock/Human Gate; exact-SHA Canonical CI #2091, Phase A #1590 and CodeQL #1241 succeeded; terminal Lock release comment 6310990853.

evidence.concurrency: Currency Rule PATCH requires exact If-Match; rate/rule lifecycle commands do not expose If-Match.
evidence.provider_boundary: Stage 69 administers existing provider/source abstraction. Production FX-provider integration and production-readiness claims remain Step 77.
evidence.unknown_outcome: No automatic replay. Non-idempotent mutations require authoritative reread/manual review. Currency apply retains a deterministic server-derived idempotency key but, because Stage69-F has no source-proven generic operation-status authority, unknown outcome is surfaced for manual review rather than blind replay.

acceptance_criteria.description: AD-D-04 exposes only source-proven currency-rate read/current, provider refresh-preview, manual register, reject/select, impact-preview and apply operations.
Provider refresh is a preview-producing command over the existing provider abstraction, validates bounded inputs, and explicitly discloses that production provider integration remains Step77.
Rate select requires WebAuthn Step-Up but does not invent Idempotency-Key; uncertain select outcome is never automatically replayed.
Impact preview separates affected_count from at-most-200 visible items, preserves the ten-minute lifetime, and treats backend warnings/guards as authoritative.
Currency apply requires WebAuthn Step-Up, exact reviewed affected count and a server-derived scoped Idempotency-Key; unknown outcome fails closed without blind replay or invented status endpoint.
UI does not claim requester binding, apply-time current-price recheck, fresh universal Profit Guard, complete scope population, or production FX-provider readiness beyond source proof.
AD-D-05 supports currency-rule list/detail/create/update/activate/deactivate only; PATCH sends exact If-Match and conflict requires reread.
All form input is bounded; Toman values are nonnegative integers, currency codes are three uppercase letters, scopes are explicit, and unsafe control characters are rejected.

Canonical closure requires exact-head Canonical CI, Phase A and CodeQL, deterministic Review, independent Security PASS, exact-artifact ACTIVE Lock, Project Owner Human Gate, protected merge, exact-SHA postmerge verification and terminal Lock release.
